assets.title: Hollow Looped Brass Bugle
assets.description: One original static stylized valveless brass bugle with a long hollow return tube, a gradually flared open bell, a separately editable hollow cup mouthpiece and two small fixed connecting stays. The entire curved tube and bell have continuous true inner and outer wall geometry; both end apertures and the assembled passage remain open. No black cavity disks or solid curved rods are used. The long U-return layout is an original authored instrument silhouette. It rests in one fixed low horizontal pose on finite flat facets of its main tube and bell, without a stand, case, player or spare components. Four closed editable meshes, constant solid PBR materials, metre scale, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. Static visual prop only: no sound, acoustic pitch, musical tuning, playability, real instrument scale, breath flow simulation, performance, ergonomic fit, manufacture, structural stability guarantee, certification or animation.
